why: An unbiased dawn pool for re-deciding what the fog class is. No fog score, no predicate, no screening -- screening a pool before a human labels it is the circularity that produced the current class.

blinding.method: The 60 frames of the current fog class are interleaved with the fresh pool under a fixed seed and the labelling tool shows an index only. The labeller cannot tell which frames were previously called fog. Every frame is served at the same width and JPEG quality, so the two arms cannot be told apart by how the picture looks either.
blinding.known_limits: The archive burns a banner into the top of every frame carrying the camera name and the exact timestamp. spike/census.html hides it with a display crop of the top 2.7%, and the files on disk are untouched -- so the blinding holds for anyone using the tool as intended, and someone who opened the JPEGs directly could still read a date. Recorded rather than claimed away.
